gold: Short-coupled polymorphic ventricular tachycardia/ventricular fibrillation (SC-PMVT/VF) variant of idiopathic ventricular fibrillation
e7_s4_rationale: The patient's ECG findings, including repetitive monomorphic premature ventricular complexes with a short-coupling interval and episodes of polymorphic ventricular tachycardia, are characteristic of catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia (CPVT). The normal cardiac structure and function, as well as the absence of obstructive coronary artery disease, also support this diagnosis.
